ideagittool.gitPath.description: Path to the Git executable. Leave empty to use git from PATH.

enumDescriptions: Native VS Code look: buttons, inputs, lists, menus, colors and fonts of the current VS Code theme, with the IntelliJ layout.
IntelliJ New UI look: the IntelliJ light/dark palette (picked by the VS Code theme kind) and IntelliJ widget shapes.
ideagittool.appearance.description: Look of the IdeaGitTool views and dialogs. The layout and the features are the same in both.

ideagittool.untrackedFiles.description: How to show unversioned files in the Commit view.

ideagittool.showIgnoredFiles.description: Show ignored files in the Commit view.

ideagittool.repositoryScanMaxDepth.description: How deep to look for nested Git repositories below each workspace folder.

ideagittool.dialogs.openInNewWindow.markdownDescription: Open dialogs (Push, Rebase, Conflicts, …) and the merge window in their own window, like IntelliJ's floating dialogs, instead of an editor tab. Uses VS Code's *Move Editor into New Window*; the window size and position are chosen by VS Code.
